design.pictures: Use separately re-encoded 480x360 H.264 25 fps clips on a verified exact relative clock. Compare 80x60 luma, a fixed 5x5 spatial block grid and the strongest five-frame median. Whole-picture mean thresholds: 65th percentile <=2.5 and 90th <=4.0. The local point is the largest ordinary development transcode response plus .35, with a floor of 1.75, separately for PCM and AAC.
design.sound: Reuse the existing 16 kHz, 160 ms waveform matches with 40 ms hop and 360 ms signed search. Require continuous matching decoded clocks and four shifted windows bracketed by same-time sound.
design.truth: Match a local 640 ms or 880 ms sound move by at least 0.60 temporal IoU and recover signed lag within 16 samples. Exact paired picture and sound witnesses, with originals before, during and after.
design.sources: Use the prior public expressive and conversational source plans, preserving their source qualification. Expressive groups 201–204 are development. Remaining expressive groups and all conversations are transfer. Every source contributes the same 15 cases per carrier; H.264 CRF alternates 31 and 34 by source group.
design.scope: Measure a moved excerpt relative to a supplied earlier copy. No assertion of original audiovisual sync, AI involvement, or generation method.
